gate_evidence.reason: Directly addresses the generative-mechanisms/statistical-structure branch question ('Which bounded cipher or pseudotext families jointly predict held-out diagnostics?') and extends the existing credited generative-falsification family with a named literature mechanism (Rugg 2004; Zandbergen 2021).

Report and manifest explicitly disclose limitations: the table is corpus-derived giving the device maximal built-in advantage, ZL3b-only, a small offset grid, no line-position modeling, and named unresolved residual metrics rather than a claim of full success.

Report explicitly compares against M2/M3/M4 prior pilots in the same family with a cross-pilot metrics table, discloses the extends/related_outcomes links, and identifies the specific narrowed residue rather than restating prior results, avoiding double counting.

All 28 tested model configurations (12 M5a + 16 M5b) are reported including worse-performing ones, plus a multi-seed stability block; interpretive percentages are explicitly labeled informal judgment rather than computed fact; no evidence of cherry-picking or concealment.
